integrity: Source gain formula and admissibility are credited to Abkin and Daripa. New scope is matching optimization, exact Gaussian curvature frontier, and zero approximation-ratio construction. Finite tests supplement an analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Single diffusion stage, two one-dimensional equal-cardinality configurations with equal positive masses, independent reflected Gaussian pairs, and spatially integrated conditional variance. Uniform-curvature regimes are sufficient, not necessary; no multi-stage claims.
title: Sharp matching phases and unbounded rank-pairing loss for Gaussian antithetic particles
